Draw a line plot from pre-computed group-by-time summaries

Source: R/lineplotSCI.R
lineplot_draw.Rd

Drawing back end shared by lineplotSCI(), which summarises raw data, and plotByVisit(), which reads the numbers off a summaryByVisit() table.

Usage

lineplot_draw(
  centre,
  lower,
  upper,
  obs,
  xs,
  at_x = xs,
  visit = as.character(at_x),
  band = any(!is.na(lower)),
  interval_type = "whiskers",
  group_names = NULL,
  group_names_short = NULL,
  dodge = 0,
  connect = TRUE,
  connect_shade = 0.15,
  main = "",
  xlab = "Time",
  ylab = "Variable",
  xlim = NULL,
  ylim = NULL,
  y_ticks = NULL,
  col = NULL,
  cex_lab = 1,
  cex_axis = 1,
  cex_n_patients = 0.7,
  risk_table = FALSE,
  missing_nr = 0,
  rotate_labels = FALSE,
  mar_custom = NULL,
  xlab_line = NULL,
  ylab_line = 3,
  xlab_position = NULL,
  lines = NULL,
  lty = 1,
  col_lines = "grey",
  legend_position = "topright",
  legend_title = NULL,
  legend_offset = c(0, 0),
  legend_cex = 1,
  legend_bty = "n",
  stat_footnote = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

centre, lower, upper

Numeric group-by-time matrices with the point estimate and the interval bounds (NA where unavailable). Row names are the group names.

obs

Integer group-by-time matrix of non-missing observations.

xs

The x coordinates of the columns of centre.

at_x

The tick positions on the x-axis.

visit

Descriptive labels for the time points. Either the name of a column in data containing the labels (bare or quoted; the first label observed at each time point is used), or a character vector with one entry per tick position. Default is NULL, which prints the time values themselves.

band

Logical; whether an error band is drawn at all.

interval_type

The style in which the error band is drawn. Either "whiskers" (the default; vertical bars with caps) or "ribbon" (a shaded polygon with a dashed border). Ignored when interval is "none".

group_names

A character vector containing the names of the groups to be displayed in the legend. The order must match levels(factor(data$group)). Default is NULL, which falls back to the group names found in the data.

group_names_short

A character vector containing short names or abbreviations for the groups, to be displayed below the x-axis near the patient counts. Optional. Defaults to group_names.

dodge

A numeric value giving the total horizontal offset applied across groups, in x-axis units, so that overlapping error bars remain readable. Default is 0 (all groups drawn at the same x position).

connect

A logical toggle switch controlling whether the point estimates within a group are joined by a line. Default is TRUE.

connect_shade

A numeric value between 0 and 1 giving how much lighter the connecting lines are drawn than the point estimates. The color is mixed with white rather than made transparent, so the lines stay opaque where they cross error bars or a ribbon. Default is 0.15 (15% lighter); 0 draws the lines in the group color.

main

Title of the plot. Defaults to "" (no title).

xlab

A label for the x-axis. Default is "Time".

ylab

A label for the y-axis. Default is "Variable".

xlim

The x-axis limits of the plot as a numeric vector of length 2. Default is NULL, which spans all tick positions and observed time points.

ylim

The y-axis limits of the plot as a numeric vector of length 2. Default is NULL, which adds a 10% padding buffer above and below the data range (band included, where one is drawn).

y_ticks

A numeric vector specifying the explicit tick positions on the y-axis. Default is NULL, which falls back to automatic tick placement.

col

A character vector of hex colors or color names to use for the groups. Recycled if shorter than the number of groups. Default is NULL, which automatically applies the SCI color palette.

cex_lab

A numeric value specifying the font size of the main axis labels. Default is 1.

cex_axis

A numeric value specifying the font size of the axis tick marks. Default is 1.

cex_n_patients

A numeric value specifying the font size of the sample size labels and numbers displayed beneath the horizontal axis. Default is 0.7.

risk_table

A logical toggle switch enabling the table of patient numbers (non-missing observations of var per group and time point) beneath the x-axis. Default is FALSE.

missing_nr

A numeric or character value indicating how zero-count patient sizes on the x-axis should be displayed. Default is 0. Can also be set to NA, which leaves the cell blank.

rotate_labels

A logical toggle switch rotating the x-axis tick labels by 90 degrees. Default is FALSE. Bottom margin and label offsets are adjusted accordingly.

mar_custom

A numeric vector indicating the plot margins to be used in the form c(bottom, left, top, right). Default is NULL, which dynamically calculates spacing so that stacked sample-size rows are never clipped.

xlab_line

A numeric value indicating the margin line offset for the x-axis label. Default is NULL, which calculates an adaptive offset based on the number of groups and on rotate_labels.

ylab_line

A numeric value indicating the margin line offset for the y-axis label. Default is 3.0.

xlab_position

Horizontal position coordinate adjustment for the sample size group headers down the left-hand margin. Default is NULL, which auto-aligns them just outside the plot region.

lines

A numeric vector indicating the vertical coordinates where horizontal reference lines will be plotted. Optional.

lty

A numeric vector of length 1 or of the same length as lines indicating the line type to be plotted. Default is 1 (solid).

col_lines

A character vector of length 1 or of the same length as lines indicating the color of the reference lines. Default is "grey".

legend_position

Position of the legend box. Options include standard base R keywords (e.g., "topright", "topleft", "bottom") or manual numeric coordinate pairs c(x, y). Default is "topright". NULL removes the legend.

legend_title

Title of the legend box. Default is NULL (no title).

legend_offset

A numeric vector of length 2 specifying an inset to nudge the legend position away from plot elements. Default is c(0, 0). Ignored when legend_position is given as coordinates.

legend_cex

A numeric value specifying the font and element scaling size inside the legend box. Default is 1.

legend_bty

The type of box border to be drawn around the legend. Allowed values are "n" (transparent/no border, the default) and "o" (standard box frame).

stat_footnote

The text of the footnote in the bottom-right corner, or NULL for none (the callers turn TRUE into their default text).

...

Further graphical parameters passed on to plot().

Value

Invisibly, a list with centre, lower, upper and n.
